Interface VirtualServer

All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiVirtualServer, SocketVirtualServer
public interface VirtualServer
Client-side, transport-agnostic proxy of the server: the facade the UI uses to talk to the server. Implementations are SocketVirtualServer and RmiVirtualServer. Usage is three-step: connect (via VirtualServerFactory), tryRegisterName(String, LocalGameState, ClientStateListener) (possibly retried), then start(); afterwards the sendXxx methods forward user actions.

  • Method Details

    • tryRegisterName

      boolean tryRegisterName(String playerName, LocalGameState localState, ClientStateListener listener)
      Negotiates the player name with the server. May be called multiple times on the same instance: each call re-uses the already-open transport (TCP socket / RMI registry stub) and only retries the name handshake.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the requested player name
      localState - the local state to be updated from server snapshots
      listener - the listener notified of inbound server events
      Returns:
      true if the server accepted the name and registered the player; false if the name was already taken (caller may retry with a different name).

    • start

      void start()
      Activates the connection after a successful tryRegisterName(String, LocalGameState, ClientStateListener): spawns the reader thread (socket) and starts the heartbeat scheduler. Must be called exactly once, after a true return from tryRegisterName(String, LocalGameState, ClientStateListener).
